C0875.title: Microsoft Security Blog Reveals Cloud Compute Theft: Attackers Exploit Automation to Abuse CPU/GPU for Mining
C0875.summary: In a July 2023 blog post, the Microsoft Security team highlighted a growing trend of compute theft targeting cloud environments, where attackers use automated methods to illegally occupy CPU or GPU resources for cryptocurrency mining.
